scope: source-code-only-plan; no actual Legacy DB rows read

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: Package manifest source identity plus separately approved DQA ConnectionProfile; never move host/username/encrypted_password/connection_options
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: Source name+DB/schema mapping with collision checks; no credential migration

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: Immutable evidence archive of every original run; latest only can appear as analysis/latest_run.json in each v2 package
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: Preserve source_id/run_id/status/times/counts/hash crosswalk; never map legacy run_id to DQA revision_id

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: Preserve all run-bound physical snapshots as source evidence; do not insert directly into DQA schema_snapshot_revisions
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: Archive full history with privacy review; DQA capture_request_id/previous_revision_id cannot be invented

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: Validated v2 tables.json and immutable catalog_import_revisions JSON
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: Use schema_name+table_name natural identity and package count parity

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: Validated v2 columns.json and immutable catalog_import_revisions JSON
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: Check ordinal, type, precision, nullable, comments; audit default SQL egress before package import
Preserve PK/UK type and composite ordering; never infer uniqueness from composite membership
Verify ordinal→column name mapping and no dangling constraints
Verify source/target table and foreign-key identity; handle out-of-scope references explicitly
Preserve indexed column order and uniqueness, exclude or redact index_definition SQL as required
Verify ordered indexed columns; detect missing/drop-column conflicts

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: categories.json categories with provenance, verified by human; revision-scoped, not inferred from DB
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: Check category_key uniqueness/name/active/sort_order; reject accidental semantic reinterpretation

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: categories.json table_assignments with source keys and provenance
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: Preserve table_key/category_key, is_primary, assignment_source, confidence and note

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: Archive historical result records separately; latest validation/preflight.json is producer evidence ONLY
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: No legacy READY→trusted VERIFIED or automatic activation; scope/issuer/expiry/evidence separate

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: DQA data_discovery_documents rebuilt from activated validated catalog_import_revision
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: Compare Gold queries, provenance, builder versions and source/revision scoping

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: Preserve legacy run-summary evidence; execute DQA revision-scoped sync/coverage test
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: Record model identity, version, dimension and coverage metrics; no run ID reuse

legacy_orm_inventory.destination: DQA data_discovery_embeddings recreated from DQA discovery documents
legacy_orm_inventory.acceptance: No raw pgvector row/ID copy; validate model_key, 1024 dims, doc fingerprint and embeddings quality

non_table_artifacts.gate: Preserve original final ZIP and DOCX/Diff/README in approved backup store; DQA imports parsed JSON+digests but not full ZIP/DOCX bytes
Keep legacy fingerprint and DQA computed fingerprint separately; never require raw hash equality
No host, username, encrypted credential or connection options copied; DQA separately approved secret refs
ERD/DOCX reporting/Target CRUD/Category editing require scoped UI decisions; no wholesale Streamlit migration
